notes: West of Vine, 8th is Garfield Place (126', centre y~4034; name from sheet 131), east of Vine E 8th (66', centre y~4141): two T's. Lippincott (printed 'LIPPINCOTT', 25') jogs ~22 px at Vine (east leg centre y 3494, west leg y 3472, west leg unnamed here); recorded as one cross at the mean. Prior Alley (printed 'PRIOR ALLEY'; 20' at Vine, 16' at Walnut) ends at Vine; the alley entering Vine from the west is offset 54 px south (centre y 2334), unnamed on this sheet (Volume 1 area), recorded as '?'. East Court St is 126' wide east of Vine but ~68' west of Vine (centres 1782 vs 1744); Vine/Court point is the centre of the four corners. East Central Parkway (147') is the old canal bed with '(E.N.Canal)' and '(E.S.Canal)' printed as the former names of its north and south roadways; points are at the centre of the full 147 ft corridor. Vine shifts slightly east north of the Parkway (centre ~1297 vs ~1283). Walnut has two water pipes (x~2885 and x~2933 north of Court); points use the block lines. East of Walnut is sheet 138 (blank except the block line), Lippincott and Prior Alley do not continue east.
